model: FlexiSmoke WSC 5xx smoke and natural ventilation panels (WSA 5MC BACnet IP module)
equipment_type: Smoke vent and natural ventilation window controller
applies_to: WindowMaster FlexiSmoke WSC 5xx modular smoke control panels fitted with the WSA 5MC BACnet IP controller module.
summary: The WSA 5MC module puts a FlexiSmoke WSC 5xx smoke and natural ventilation panel on BACnet IP. Objects cover up to 13 motor groups and the motor lines on modules S1 and S3-S5: maximum, auto and hand position commands, actual and maximum positions, close commands, closed and error status, plus smoke zone alarms and errors, wind speed and direction, connection values and bit-string status words for groups, lines, smoke zones and the system.
notes: The PICS lists objects as ranges (for example AO 1..13 Max_position_motor_group_1..13). Only the first object of each range is listed; the description gives the range. Instance n of a range ends in _n (groups and smoke zones 1-13, motor lines X1-X4).
Total objects in the PICS: 266 across all ranges.
AV 27-30 (Hand_position_motor_line_S3_X1..4) are printed with the prefix "AI" inside the Analog Value table; they are listed as AV.
The Bit String Value objects (BS 1-40) are listed as type Other; their bit meanings are in the PICS.
Same product family as the WSC 3xx / WCC 3xx list, but a different object set.

source.title: WSC 5xx PICS - Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement

integration.summary: Command window positions per motor group with the AO position objects, read actual positions and closed status per motor line, and map the smoke zone alarms and the system error. Wind values come from the panel weather inputs.
